summary_zh: 魅力 +1（最高 20）；擅長模仿他人的聲音與姿態，並在偽裝成他人時更容易蒙混過關。
summary_en: Increase Charisma by 1 (maximum 20); improve voice and mannerism mimicry and deception while impersonating someone.

summary_zh: 先攻獲得 +5 加值；保持清醒時不會被突襲，且看不見的敵人不會因隱匿而取得對你的攻擊優勢。
summary_en: Gain +5 initiative, cannot be surprised while conscious, and unseen attackers gain no advantage solely from being unseen.

summary_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20）；起立消耗更少移動力，攀爬更快，並可在助跑後跳得更遠。
summary_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20); stand faster, climb faster, and make longer running jumps.

summary_zh: 以疾走動作直線移動至少 10 呎後，可用附贈動作近戰攻擊或推撞；命中時可強化傷害或推遠目標。
summary_en: After dashing at least 10 feet straight toward a creature, use a bonus action to attack or shove it; an attack can gain extra damage or a shove can push farther.

summary_zh: 忽略弩的裝填限制；近戰敵人不會使你的遠程攻擊劣勢；以單手武器攻擊後可用附贈動作射擊手弩。
summary_en: Ignore crossbow loading, avoid disadvantage on ranged attacks from nearby foes, and fire a hand crossbow as a bonus action after a one-handed-weapon attack.

summary_zh: 持用靈巧武器時，可用反應將熟練加值加到一次針對你的近戰攻擊 AC 上。
summary_en: While wielding a finesse weapon, use a reaction to add your proficiency bonus to AC against one melee attack.

summary_zh: 雙持時 AC +1；可雙持非輕型單手近戰武器，並可在同一次互動中拔出或收起兩把單手武器。
summary_en: Gain +1 AC while dual wielding, use two non-light one-handed melee weapons, and draw or stow two one-handed weapons together.

summary_zh: 更善於發現祕門與陷阱；對陷阱豁免有優勢、陷阱傷害減半，並可更快搜尋祕門。
summary_en: Improve detection of secret doors and traps; gain advantage on saves against traps, resistance to their damage, and search for secret doors faster.

summary_zh: 體質 +1（最高 20）；花費生命骰恢復生命值時，每顆骰的最低恢復量為體質調整值的兩倍。
summary_en: Increase Constitution by 1 (maximum 20); when spending Hit Dice, each die restores at least twice your Constitution modifier.

prerequisite_en: Ability to cast at least one spell
summary_zh: 選擇一種傷害類型（酸、冷、火、閃電或雷鳴）；你的法術忽略該類型抗性，且傷害骰的 1 視為 2。
summary_en: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Your spells ignore resistance to it, and damage die rolls of 1 count as 2.

summary_zh: 對被你擒抱的生物進行攻擊時具有優勢，並可嘗試讓自己與對方同時陷入束縛。
summary_en: Gain advantage on attacks against creatures you grapple and can attempt to restrain both yourself and the grappled target.

summary_zh: 近戰重擊或將敵人生命值降至 0 時，可附贈動作再攻擊一次；重型武器攻擊可選擇承受命中減值以換取大幅傷害加值。
summary_en: After a melee critical hit or reducing a creature to 0 hit points, make a bonus-action attack; take an attack-roll penalty with a heavy weapon for substantial bonus damage.

summary_zh: 力量 +1（最高 20），並獲得重甲熟練。
summary_en: Increase Strength by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with heavy armor.

summary_zh: 力量 +1（最高 20）；穿著重甲時，非魔法武器造成的鈍擊、穿刺、揮砍傷害會減少。
summary_en: Increase Strength by 1 (maximum 20); while wearing heavy armor, reduce nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapons.

summary_zh: 花 10 分鐘鼓舞同伴，讓最多六名生物獲得臨時生命值；休息後可再次使用。
summary_en: Spend 10 minutes inspiring up to six creatures, granting temporary hit points; use again after a rest.

summary_zh: 智力 +1（最高 20）；能辨識方位、知道日出日落前的剩餘時間，並能精確回憶近期所見所聞。
summary_en: Increase Intelligence by 1 (maximum 20); always know direction, time to sunrise or sunset, and accurately recall recent sights and sounds.

summary_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得輕甲熟練。
summary_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with light armor.

summary_zh: 智力 +1（最高 20）；學會三種語言，並可創造他人難以破譯的書寫密碼。
summary_en: Increase Intelligence by 1 (maximum 20), learn three languages, and create written ciphers others struggle to decipher.

summary_zh: 獲得幸運點，可在攻擊、能力檢定、豁免或敵人攻擊你時擲額外 d20 並選擇結果；長休後恢復。
summary_en: Gain luck points to roll an extra d20 for your attacks, checks, saves, or an attack against you and choose the result; regain them after a long rest.

summary_zh: 附近敵人施法時可用反應近戰攻擊；可擾亂其專注，並對其法術豁免具有優勢。
summary_en: React with a melee attack when a nearby creature casts a spell; disrupt its concentration and gain advantage on saves against its spells.

summary_zh: 選擇一個職業的法術列表，學會兩個戲法及一個一環法術；該一環法術每次長休可免費施展一次。
summary_en: Choose a class spell list, learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell; cast that spell once for free per long rest.

summary_zh: 學會兩個戰鬥大師戰技，並獲得一顆較小的卓越骰；短休或長休後恢復。
summary_en: Learn two Battle Master maneuvers and gain one smaller superiority die, restored on a short or long rest.

summary_zh: 穿中甲不再有潛行劣勢，且可將更高的敏捷調整值加入 AC。
summary_en: Medium armor no longer imposes Stealth disadvantage and permits a higher Dexterity contribution to AC.

summary_zh: 速度增加；疾走時可忽略困難地形；近戰攻擊過的生物當回合無法藉機會攻擊阻止你離開。
summary_en: Increase speed, ignore difficult terrain while dashing, and avoid opportunity attacks from creatures you have made a melee attack against that turn.

summary_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得中甲與盾牌熟練。
summary_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

summary_zh: 騎乘時可保護坐騎免受攻擊；對較小的未騎乘生物近戰攻擊有優勢，且坐騎敏捷豁免成功時可免受傷害。
summary_en: While mounted, protect your mount from attacks, gain advantage on melee attacks against smaller unmounted creatures, and let your mount take no damage on successful Dexterity saves.

summary_zh: 智力或感知 +1（最高 20）；能讀唇語，且被動感知與被動調查提高。
summary_en: Increase Intelligence or Wisdom by 1 (maximum 20); read lips and improve passive Perception and Investigation.

summary_zh: 以長柄武器攻擊後可用附贈動作以武器另一端攻擊；生物進入你的觸及範圍時會引發機會攻擊。
summary_en: After attacking with a qualifying polearm, make a bonus-action butt-end attack; creatures entering your reach provoke opportunity attacks.

summary_zh: 一項屬性 +1（最高 20），並獲得該屬性的豁免熟練。
summary_en: Increase one ability score by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

summary_zh: 獲得儀式書，可選擇一個職業法術列表中的兩個一環儀式法術，並可持續把新的儀式加入書中。
summary_en: Gain a ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from one class list and the ability to add additional ritual spells to it.

summary_zh: 每回合一次，近戰武器攻擊造成傷害時可重擲傷害骰並選擇使用其中一個結果。
summary_en: Once per turn when rolling melee-weapon damage, reroll the damage dice and use either total.

summary_zh: 機會攻擊命中會使目標速度歸零；敵人即使撤離也會引發你的機會攻擊，且可反應攻擊打向同伴的附近敵人。
summary_en: Your opportunity-attack hits stop movement; foes provoke even when disengaging, and you can react to attack a nearby foe targeting an ally.

summary_zh: 遠程攻擊忽略遠距離劣勢與大部分掩蔽；可選擇承受命中減值以換取大幅傷害加值。
summary_en: Ranged attacks ignore long-range disadvantage and most cover; take an attack-roll penalty for substantial bonus damage.

summary_zh: 攻擊動作中先以單手武器攻擊後，可附贈動作推撞；盾牌可協助敏捷豁免，並在部分成功豁免時避免傷害。
summary_en: After a one-handed weapon attack in your Attack action, bonus-action shove; your shield helps on Dexterity saves and can prevent damage from certain successful saves.

summary_zh: 獲得任選三項技能或工具熟練。
summary_en: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

summary_zh: 昏暗光線不會妨礙依靠視覺的感知；躲藏時未命中的遠程攻擊不會暴露你的位置，且可更容易躲在略被遮蔽處。
summary_en: Dim light does not hinder sight-based Perception; missed ranged attacks while hidden do not reveal you, and you can hide more easily when lightly obscured.

prerequisite_en: Ability to cast at least one spell
summary_zh: 施放需要攻擊擲骰的法術時，射程加倍且忽略半掩蔽與四分之三掩蔽；另學會一個攻擊戲法。
summary_en: Double range for spells requiring attack rolls, ignore half and three-quarters cover, and learn one attack cantrip.

summary_zh: 力量或體質 +1（最高 20）；徒手打擊更強、獲得即興武器熟練，且攻擊命中後可附贈動作嘗試擒抱。
summary_en: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1 (maximum 20); improve unarmed strikes, gain improvised-weapon proficiency, and bonus-action grapple after a hit.

summary_zh: 你的生命值上限會隨等級獲得額外提升，並追溯計入已取得的等級。
summary_en: Your hit point maximum increases with your level, including retroactively for levels already gained.

prerequisite_en: Ability to cast at least one spell
summary_zh: 進行專注豁免時具優勢；手持武器或盾牌也能施展姿勢成分法術；可用單一目標法術進行機會攻擊。
summary_en: Gain advantage on concentration saves, cast somatic spells with weapons or a shield in hand, and use a single-target spell for opportunity attacks.

summary_zh: 力量或敏捷 +1（最高 20），並獲得任選四種簡易或軍用武器熟練。
summary_en: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1 (maximum 20) and gain proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice.
